dct_description_sm:
WWTP is the ID of the wastewater treatment plant (WWTP). There are 11 wastewater treatment plants in Alberta that were included in the paper plus a 12th (V12) virtual WWTP that is a combination of WWTPs 1, 2, 4-9, and 11. V12 includes all of the sites that had data collected until March 15, 2022. 

Day is the date of the wastewater sample collection.

WWviral is the 7-day rolling average of SARS-CoV-2 RNA level (genome copies/100ml).

Cases is the number of new COVID-19 cases in the geographic area served by the WWTP.

Mising data are denoted by NA.

For 11 wastewater treatment plants in Alberta, Canada, during May 10, 2020, to March 15, 2022, the 7-day rolling average of SARS-CoV-2 RNA levels and the number of new COVID-19 cases in the catchment area of the plant are provided daily.
dct_title_s: Wastewater SARS-CoV-2 RNA level and COVID-19 cases for 11 Alberta sites during May 10, 2020, to March 15, 2022
